text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp.
Victoire Pisa was dedicating herself
to training day after day with impeccable
effort.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Phew...
choice_data_list: Great work. Let's head back and ca...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you very much for today as
well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um... if you wouldn't mind,
would you like to take a walk with me?
I want to feel close to the beautiful ocean.
As a memory of our camp.
choice_data_list: Sounds great, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...—Here is another one.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Sea glass... It's wonderful,
isn't it? A jagged fragment softened
until it holds such a gentle light...
like a gem polished by the sea.
choice_data_list: You're right... It really is gorge...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes...♪
Oh, there's more over there...

Whenever she found a lost treasure of the
sea
lying all alone—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Drifting out to sea all alone,
traveling for such a long time...
and returning from somewhere far away.
A beautiful... blissful circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It's all right,
you're not lonely anymore.

With an angelic smile, she gently
gathered each and every one.

Continuing our stroll, before we knew it,
we reached a crowded area.
Glancing down at our feet, there was—
choice_data_list: (A crab. In a place like this...?)

text_block_list.text:
The crab tottered along,
weaving between people's steps.
However, being so tiny,
it was hard for passersby to notice—
choice_data_list: Ah! Watch your step, please...!

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Customer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... A crab?!
...That was close,
I almost stepped on it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Oh my... Who is this little one...?
choice_data_list: It's trying to cross here, but it ...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I see... So small and all alone,
it must feel so helpless...
Is it on its way home, I wonder...?
choice_data_list: Can we watch over it until it reac...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Yes, of course...!
Please let me watch over it with you.
Praying for its safe journey—

The crab made it through the crowd and safely
reached an open space.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's going so smoothly. At this rate—...
Oh?
Oh dear...!

Looking where she was gazing...
In the crab's path lay a pile of driftwood
and debris.
choice_data_list: It won't be able to get through li...
It won't be able to get through li...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as it is—...
I'll... clear a path for it!
choice_data_list: I'll help too!
I'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all right...
Please wait just a moment.
You'll be able to move forward very soon.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Little crab, over this way.
...Yes, step by step,
one step at a time...
choice_data_list: Whoa... It's like it's being guide...
Whoa... It's like it's being guide...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe...
My words are merely a humble nudge.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Forward,
ever forward. No matter how small the steps,
as long as you move forward with hope...
you can always return to where warmth
awaits.
choice_data_list: (I see...)

text_block_list.text:
As long as there is hope,
you can reach a warm place—
We watched over its tiny, earnest struggle,
believing in it like a prayer.
choice_data_list: You can do it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer...
You have such an earnest gaze...
Cherishing each little step with such love
and care...)
choice_data_list: Look, Pisa! It's made so much prog...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yes, it truly has...!

Reaching the rocky shore,
several other crabs came into view.

As if welcomed by its companions,
the crab eventually slipped into the crevice
between the rocks.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It made it... safely.
This is the precious place...
it wanted to return home to.
choice_data_list: Its family, maybe? Looks like they...
Its family, maybe? Looks like they...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Hehe...
'What's taking so long?
Are they here yet?'...
Perhaps they were too worried to sit still
and came out to greet it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It's not all alone anymore.
To return to the circle where it feels most
safe... I am so glad, truly.
choice_data_list: May it never face danger again...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
May they all... live happily
together from now on.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (And may their circle—)
choice_data_list: May their circle never be broken.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... That's how it's always been...
All this time, always...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(Your happiness... is my joy.
Our happiness has always been together,
side by side—...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today's sunset... is so beautiful.
It seems to shine so much brighter than
usual.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In your eyes,
I see that very same light shining.
Yes, I am certain of it—...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Right,
you pass it through this loop—...
and pull it tight.
That's how you weave it.

Back at the inn, Victoire Pisa and I
were making charms using hemp twine and the
sea glass we found.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Just like this... let's weave it so
it wraps around the sea glass.
...—Like so.
choice_data_list: Hmm, I can't seem to make it as pr...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You're doing wonderfully.
I can feel your heartfelt wish to weave it
tightly.

Taught patiently by Victoire Pisa,
at last—
choice_data_list: I-It's finished...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You did it...! Every single knot
is so neat and aligned,
simply lovely... As expected of you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... A matching pair, right?

Having spent so much time...
pouring our feelings into making them,
I've grown truly fond of it.

Still, since we made it...
I want her to have it as a memento of
today.
choice_data_list: Pisa, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Um, if you wouldn't mind—

"Let's trade!"—
our warm words rang out in unison.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Hehehe.
Even before we put it into words...
our hearts were already one—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep weaving it together.
From now on... endlessly,
unchangingly. With both of our hands.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And... may this bond never come undone.
